description: Matter analytics and time-tracking workspace for litigation attorneys — sidebar-driven app with caseload dashboard, billable-hours tracking, deadline calendar, and matter detail views

pages.name: dashboard
pages.description: Practice overview showing daily billables, active matters, and upcoming deadlines
components: Persistent left sidebar with firm name, attorney initials, primary nav (Dashboard, Matters, Time, Calendar, Clients), a 'Start timer' action, and a footer running-timer indicator
Top utility bar with breadcrumb 'Today', a date stepper, a global search input scoped to matters/clients, and a 'Log time' button

Row of four metric tiles: Billable hours today (goal-progress ring), Billable hours this week (7-day bar mini-chart), Realization rate (percent with delta), Matters touched today (count + avatar stack)

Two-column area — left 'Active matters' table (matter code, caption, client, practice area, last activity, hours sparkline); right 'Upcoming deadlines' list (jurisdiction badge, deadline type, days-remaining chip, attorney)
Bottom strip 'Recent time entries' as a compact table with start time, duration, matter code, narrative excerpt, billable toggle, and a status pill (Draft, Submitted, Billed)

pages.name: matters
pages.description: Filterable caseload list of every active and archived matter
components: Same persistent sidebar
Page header with title 'Matters', a result count, a 'New matter' primary button, and a view toggle (Table / Board)
Filter bar with chips for Practice area, Status (Active, On hold, Closed), Lead attorney dropdown, Client dropdown, Jurisdiction dropdown, and a date-opened range picker

Main matters table with columns: matter code, caption, client, practice area, lead attorney (avatar + name), opened date, last activity, hours MTD, fees MTD, status pill, and a row-hover overflow menu
Pagination footer with rows-per-page selector, page range indicator, and an 'Export to CSV' link

pages.name: matter-detail
pages.description: Single matter workspace with parties, timeline, documents, and billing summary
components: Same persistent sidebar
Matter header with breadcrumb, matter caption as title, sub-row (client, opened date, lead attorney, jurisdiction, status pill), and actions 'Start timer', 'Add deadline', 'Generate invoice'

Horizontal tab strip (Overview, Parties, Timeline, Documents, Time & fees, Notes) above a two-column body: 'Parties' card (opposing counsel, judge, client contacts) and 'Key dates' card (filed, next hearing, SOL, trial)

Right column 'Activity timeline' as a vertical thread of dated entries (filings, calls, emails, time logs, document uploads) each with an event-type icon, actor, summary, and a duration chip when applicable

Bottom 'Billing summary' panel with a stacked-bar chart of monthly fees vs costs, a fees-to-date / retainer-remaining pair, and a small table of the five most recent invoices (number, date, amount, status)

pages.name: time
pages.description: Weekly timesheet for reviewing, editing, and submitting billable entries
components: Same persistent sidebar
Header with title 'Timesheet', a week-of date stepper, a target-vs-actual hours indicator for the week, and buttons 'Add entry' and 'Submit week'

Weekly grid with rows grouped by matter and columns for each day of the week — each cell shows logged hours, hovering reveals entry count, and a totals row across the bottom plus a totals column on the right

Below the grid, an 'Unsubmitted entries' list where each row contains matter code, date, duration stepper, billable toggle, activity-code dropdown (UTBMS task code), a narrative text field, and a delete control
Side panel 'Timer' docked to the right with a large running clock, matter selector, activity-code selector, narrative textarea, and Stop / Discard buttons

pages.name: calendar
pages.description: Deadline and court-date calendar with jurisdiction-aware rules
components: Same persistent sidebar
Header with title 'Calendar', view toggle (Month / Week / Agenda), date navigator, a 'Filter by matter' multi-select, and an 'Add deadline' primary button

Month grid with day cells showing date number, an indicator for court holidays per selected jurisdiction, and stacked event chips colored by event type (Filing deadline, Hearing, Deposition, Internal)

Right-hand 'Selected day' panel listing the day's events in order with time, event type icon, matter caption, location/courtroom, assigned attorneys (avatar stack), and a 'Compute deadline chain' link

Bottom 'Rule-based deadlines' helper showing a small form with trigger event dropdown, jurisdiction dropdown, and a generated checklist of downstream deadlines with proposed dates and a 'Add all to calendar' button

pages.name: client-detail
pages.description: Client profile aggregating all matters, contacts, and billing history
components: Same persistent sidebar

Client header with breadcrumb (Clients / [name]), client name as title, sub-row with client type (Corporate / Individual), industry, primary contact, originating attorney, and an 'Open conflict check' action
Three-up summary cards: Lifetime fees billed, Outstanding A/R (with an aging bar broken into 0–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / 90+ segments), and Active matters count

Two-column body — left 'Matters' table (code, caption, status, lead attorney, opened, fees YTD); right column stacked with a 'Contacts' card (name, title, email, phone, role) and an 'Engagement letters' card
Bottom 'Invoice history' table with invoice number, issued date, period, amount, paid date, and status pill, plus a row of quick-filter chips above for All / Outstanding / Paid / Overdue
